verdict.rationale: Formant documents several APIs (Admin, query and ingestion APIs) and SDKs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on all of them, and llms.txt is a docs index, not an API spec.
